# Jeseem Tours & Travels

> Premier Travel Agency & Tour Operator in Alappuzha, Kerala, India (Established 1985).

Jeseem Tours & Travels is a premier, 40+-year-old travel consultancy based in Thiruvampady, Alappuzha, Kerala, India. Founded in 1985 by Late Kunjumon Ismail, the agency specializes in worldwide group flight bookings, special and series airline fares, customized domestic and international holiday tour packages (Dubai, Maldives, Georgia, Malaysia, Kerala backwaters, Lakshadweep), fast-track tourist & business visa assistance, certificate attestation (HRD, MEA, Apostille, Embassy), and sacred Hajj & Umrah pilgrimage packages.

## Primary Services Offered
1. **Worldwide Flight Ticket Bookings**: Exclusive group flight allocations, special airline series fares, corporate ticketing, and lowest airfare routes from Cochin International Airport (COK), Trivandrum (TRV), Calicut (CCJ), and Kannur (CNN).
2. **International Tour Packages**: Custom tailored holiday packages departing from Kerala to Dubai (UAE), Maldives luxury resorts, Georgia (Caucasus mountains), and Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur & Langkawi).
3. **Domestic & Kerala Holiday Packages**: Alappuzha backwater private luxury houseboats, Munnar tea plantation hill retreats, Wayanad eco-tourism, and Lakshadweep coral reef scuba expeditions.
4. **Global Visa Assistance**: Tourist, visit, and business visa guidance for UAE/Dubai e-visa, Schengen Europe, UK, USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Southeast Asia.
5. **Certificate Attestation & Emigration**: Fast-track HRD, MEA Apostille, Embassy legalization, and Emigration Clearance (POE) support.
6. **Hajj & Umrah Pilgrimage**: Dedicated coordinated holy pilgrimages to Makkah and Madinah with hotels close to Haram and experienced multilingual guides.
